scope: Independent offline arithmetic, recorded receipt identity, and committed instrumentation-semantics review; no VM, source edits, builds or tests.

semantics.greater_than_99_denominator: wait_episodes: actual delegation result-wait helper episodes, not all lock acquisitions, descriptor claims, returned JIT bodies, CPU time or parking rate.
semantics.numerator: initial_budget_completed: retained initial pin and budget_expired false at the initial wait-phase finish.
semantics.claims: Exact private current-descriptor reservations. Ordinary READY execution does not store CLAIMED; claims and retired_claims are not notification-store counts or returned-body counts.
semantics.retain_current_calls: Calls retaining an existing current at epoch closure, including already-CLAIMED retention; not exact promotion-store count.
semantics.ready_cohort: Once per successful epoch admission, before selecting a current, observe a bounded compatible linked READY prefix on distinct nonself CPUs. Bin8 means at least8 observed candidates; it does not promise8 future executions or describe every iteration.
semantics.one_not_ready_at36: Preserved as one failed selection, one occupancy-after0 and one selection_result.current_not_ready; no bin is discarded. The underlying node state was not recorded, so its cause is not inferred.

limits: Both are optional mode2 instrumented, single-round c01 points; no performance comparison or acceptance is made.
100% within-budget holds for these observed wait episodes only; no universal >99% guarantee, wall-time spinning fraction, absence of all scheduling, or lock-parking rate is established.

The supplied bundle contains result.json plus before/after/delta counters, but no raw session/measurement logs, per-session returned-body counters, source-retirement receipts, or provider ELF/modinfo. Complete/final-idle identities are verified as recorded; those missing raw facts cannot be independently revalidated from this input.
The diagnostic schema conservation checks cannot themselves prove execution, ownership or source/frame drain. Full archive integrity and live validation remain separate evidence.
